title: cleome obtusa var. gamboensis
intro: Cleome obtusa var. gamboensis, commonly known as the Gambo cleome, is a plant species that belongs to the Cleomaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cleome obtusa var. gamboensis include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimalarial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
